location_search_areas_geometry_extent_ch.name: location_search_areas_geometry_extent_check

(

          "location_search_areas"."geometry_count" = 0
          AND "location_search_areas"."lon" IS NULL
          AND "location_search_areas"."lat" IS NULL
          AND "location_search_areas"."min_lon" IS NULL
          AND "location_search_areas"."min_lat" IS NULL
          AND "location_search_areas"."max_lon" IS NULL
          AND "location_search_areas"."max_lat" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "location_search_areas"."geometry_count" > 0
          AND "location_search_areas"."lon" IS NOT NULL
          AND "location_search_areas"."lat" IS NOT NULL
          AND "location_search_areas"."min_lon" IS NOT NULL
          AND "location_search_areas"."min_lat" IS NOT NULL
          AND "location_search_areas"."max_lon" IS NOT NULL
          AND "location_search_areas"."max_lat" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

property_tile_pyramid_nodes_coord_check.name: property_tile_pyramid_nodes_coord_check
property_tile_pyramid_nodes_coord_check.value:
"property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."z" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."z" <= 22
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."x" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."y" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."x" < (1::bigint << "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."z")
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."y" < (1::bigint << "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."z")
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."render_lon" >= -180
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."render_lon" <= 180
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."render_lat" >= -90
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."render_lat" <= 90

property_tile_pyramid_nodes_counts_check.name: property_tile_pyramid_nodes_counts_check
property_tile_pyramid_nodes_counts_check.value:
"property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."point_count" > 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."preview_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."preview_count" <= "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."point_count"
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."preview_count" = cardinality("property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."preview_property_ids")
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."active_listing_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."completed_listing_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."social_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."recent_social_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."social_score_total" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."social_score_max" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."recent_social_score_total" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."comment_count" >= 0
        AND ("property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."tap_radius_px" IS NULL OR "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."tap_radius_px" >= 0)
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."tap_priority_score" >= 0

property_tile_pyramid_nodes_bbox_check.name: property_tile_pyramid_nodes_bbox_check
property_tile_pyramid_nodes_bbox_check.value:
(
          "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_west" IS NULL
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_south" IS NULL
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_east" IS NULL
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_north" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_west" IS NOT NULL
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_south" IS NOT NULL
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_east" IS NOT NULL
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_north" IS NOT NULL
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_west" <= "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_east"
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_south" <= "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_north"
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_west" >= -180
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_east" <= 180
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_south" >= -90
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_nodes"."bbox_north" <= 90
        )

property_tile_pyramid_tiles_payload_chec.name: property_tile_pyramid_tiles_payload_check
property_tile_pyramid_tiles_payload_chec.value:
"property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."node_count" >= 0
        AND (
          ("property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."tile_status" = 'pending' AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."payload" IS NULL)
          OR (
            "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."tile_status" = 'valid_empty'
            AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."node_count" = 0
            AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."payload" IS NULL
            AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."etag" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR (
            "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."tile_status" = 'valid_nodes'
            AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."node_count" > 0
            AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."payload" IS NULL
            AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."etag" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR (
            "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."tile_status" = 'valid_encoded'
            AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."payload" IS NOT NULL
            AND octet_length("property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."payload") > 0
            AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."etag" IS NOT NULL
            AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."payload_sha256" IS NOT NULL
            AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."payload_generated_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR ("property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."tile_status" = 'failed' AND "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."payload" IS NULL)
        )

property_tile_pyramid_tiles_validation_c.name: property_tile_pyramid_tiles_validation_check
property_tile_pyramid_tiles_validation_c.value:
("property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."validation_status" <> 'validated' OR "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."validation_status" <> 'failed' OR "property_tile_pyramid_tiles"."last_error" IS NOT NULL)

property_tile_pyramid_versions_counts_ch.name: property_tile_pyramid_versions_counts_check
property_tile_pyramid_versions_counts_ch.value:
"property_tile_pyramid_versions"."attempt_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."max_attempts" > 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."expected_tile_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."validated_tile_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."non_empty_tile_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."node_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."member_row_count" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."encoded_payload_bytes" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."heap_bytes" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."index_bytes" >= 0
        AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."wal_bytes" >= 0
        AND ("property_tile_pyramid_versions"."build_duration_ms" IS NULL OR "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."build_duration_ms" >= 0)

property_tile_pyramid_versions_status_ti.name: property_tile_pyramid_versions_status_timestamps_check
property_tile_pyramid_versions_status_ti.value:
("property_tile_pyramid_versions"."status" = 'promoted') = ("property_tile_pyramid_versions"."promoted_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("property_tile_pyramid_versions"."status" <> 'failed_terminal' OR "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."terminal_reason" IS NOT NULL)

property_tile_pyramid_versions_failed_ti.name: property_tile_pyramid_versions_failed_tile_check
property_tile_pyramid_versions_failed_ti.value:
("property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_z" IS NULL AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_x" IS NULL AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_y" IS NULL)
        OR (
          "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_z" IS NOT NULL
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_x" IS NOT NULL
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_y" IS NOT NULL
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_z" >= 0
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_z" <= 22
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_x" >= 0
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_y" >= 0
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_x" < (1::bigint << "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_z")
          AND "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_y" < (1::bigint << "property_tile_pyramid_versions"."failed_z")
        )

property_tile_snapshots_payload_check.name: property_tile_snapshots_payload_check
property_tile_snapshots_payload_check.value:
(
        ("property_tile_snapshots"."status_code" = 200 AND "property_tile_snapshots"."payload" IS NOT NULL AND octet_length("property_tile_snapshots"."payload") > 0)
        OR ("property_tile_snapshots"."status_code" = 204 AND "property_tile_snapshots"."payload" IS NULL)
      )

property_views_identity_required_chk.name: property_views_identity_required_chk
property_views_identity_required_chk.value: "property_views"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "property_views"."session_id" IS NOT NULL
